long_biography.plain_text:
Christofer Michael “Chris” Par built his career in the business of aesthetic medicine rather than clinical practice. He founded Sono Bello in 2008 and developed Body Contour Centers as the management platform behind its cosmetic-surgery clinics. The network specialised in body-contouring procedures and expanded across the United States. Par held a majority interest in the management business as it grew, while physicians working through a separate practice delivered the medical care.

He subsequently became the company’s executive chairman. When new investors supplied expansion capital, existing owners retained control of the business. Sono Bello continued opening clinics under a separate chief executive, leaving Par in a founder and strategic-leadership role rather than the medical or day-to-day chief-executive position.
